text: Import existing files from Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, or the local machine
quote: Import your existing files from Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud, or your local machine.

text: Import notes and memory archives from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear and other tools into Poly Mind
quote: Bring existing notes and memory archives into Poly Mind from Notion, Obsidian, Evernote, Bear, and more.

text: Natural-language search inside files that returns results down to the exact timestamp, page, paragraph, or frame
quote: Search inside your files with natural language that's gives you results down to the exact timestamp, page, paragraph, or frame.

text: Scope a search to a single folder by right-clicking it and choosing Search within
quote: To search within one folder, right-click it and choose Search within...

text: Find images that look visually similar to a reference image you provide
quote: Visual similarity — find images that look like a reference image you provide

text: Find images that contain a specific color or palette
quote: Visual similarity — find images that look like a reference image you provide; Color search — find images that contain a specific color or palette

text: Automatically parses, transcribes, and indexes files so agents can read and understand them up to 20x faster
quote: It automatically parses, transcribes, and indexes your files that make it up to 20x faster for an agent to read and understand them.

text: Automatically remembers key details from your files to build a second-brain memory
quote: Poly automatically remembers key details, forming a "second brain" for you out of your files.

text: Poly Mind memories are transparent and fully editable by the user
quote: Poly Mind's memories of you are fully editable and transparent. Open Mind to inspect your memories or make changes.

text: Plugin connects Poly to agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code
quote: Use our plugin with leading agents like Claude, ChatGPT, and VS Code and make your file workflows insanely fast.

text: Claude Code plugin loads your Poly profile and recent memories into context automatically at session start
quote: When Claude Code starts, the plugin runs poly memory summary against the local Poly app. Your profile and recent memories are added to Claude's context automatically

text: Official Claude plugin teaches Claude how to use Poly and connects the Poly MCP server
quote: The official plugin loads your Poly memory when each session starts, teaches Claude how to use Poly, and connects the Poly MCP server.

text: Hosted MCP server over streamable HTTP with OAuth browser sign-in and no API keys to manage
quote: MCP clients can connect to https://mcp.poly.app/mcp (streamable HTTP). Authentication is OAuth... There are no API keys to generate or manage.

text: Irreversible actions are blocked over MCP: rm only archives, and permanent deletion is reserved for the user
quote: Irreversible actions are blocked over MCP: rm archives files (reversible), and permanently deleting from the Archive is reserved for you

text: Official poly command-line tool for searching and scripting your files from the terminal, bundled with the desktop app
quote: poly is Poly's command-line tool: your files, searchable and scriptable from the terminal. It ships inside the desktop app—there's no separate download.

text: CLI can copy between local disk and Poly and download a URL straight into Poly
quote: cp — Copy between local disk and Poly, or within Poly ... wget — Download a URL straight into Poly

text: poly-cli agent skill teaches agents to search, read, create, update, and organize Poly files using poly commands
quote: teaches an agent how to search, read, create, update, and organize your Poly files by composing poly commands.

text: List any folder at any past time and read files at a specific revision
quote: it lets you list any folder at any time in the past, as well as read files at a particular revision as they looked at that time.

text: Flashback mode rewinds the actual folder or file view to show exactly how it looked at any moment in the past
quote: Flashback is time travel for your files. Open it and your current view — a folder, a file — gains a timeline of its entire past. Scroll, and you're not looking at a list of version entries: **the view itself rewinds**, re-rendering your fol

text: Roll back individual files or whole folders to a past state in one click
quote: Go into flashback mode at any time to see exactly what your files looked like at any point in the past, down to the second. Rollback your files, or whole folders in a click.

text: Undo one specific change while keeping all changes made after it
quote: undo one specific change while keeping everything that happened after it.

text: Parallel edits are kept as conflict revisions that can be opened, downloaded, or restored like any other version
quote: Any parallel edits are stored as conflict revisions... and can be opened, peeked, downloaded, or restored like any other version.

text: Built-in agent writes and edits files directly, keeping the original in version history for rollback
quote: The agent modifies the file content and saves the changes. The original version is preserved in version history, so you can roll back if needed.

text: Agent is aware of the file or folder you are viewing and can summarize, explain, or edit it
quote: The agent sees what you see, so you can ask it about the file you're reading, or the folder you're browsing. Ask it to summarize, explain, or even edit your files.

text: Agent handles multi-step tasks spanning reading, searching, writing, and organizing in a single request
quote: The Poly agent can handle tasks that span multiple steps — reading, searching, writing, and organizing — in a single request.

text: Ask the agent to automate tasks such as organizing a folder
quote: Ask it to summarize, explain, or even edit your files. Automate tasks like organizing a folder.

text: Agent can process every file in a folder, e.g. extracting invoice fields into a CSV
quote: Go through every invoice in the Finance/Invoices folder, extract the vendor name, amount, and date from each one, and create a CSV with that data

text: Agents can spawn subagents, assign and track their tasks, and let agents communicate and share learnings
quote: Your agent can spawn its own subagents, assign them tasks, and track their progress. Moreover, agents/subagents can communicate with each other and share learnings.

text: Finder tags sync bidirectionally with Poly tags, including colors
quote: Tags & colors: Finder tags sync bidirectionally with Poly tags, colors included.

text: Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, downloading on demand and syncing back automatically
quote: your Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, with files downloading on demand and syncing back automatically.

text: Pin files or folders to keep them downloaded and never evicted, with pinning cascading to folder contents
quote: Keep Downloaded (pinned) — the content is downloaded eagerly and never evicted. Pinning a folder cascades to everything inside it.

text: Offline changes are queued across restarts and sync automatically once you reconnect
quote: The queue survives restarts, so work done on a plane syncs itself when you land

text: Uploading whole folders preserves folder structure and metadata such as tags and colors
quote: You can drop entire folders, and Poly preserves your folder structure as it uploads. Metadata such as tags and colors are preserved

text: Share files or folders with specific people or anyone with a link, stay the owner, and revoke access anytime
quote: Share a file or folder when the content belongs to you and you want specific people — or anyone with a link — to see it. You stay the owner, and you can revoke access at any time.

text: Share links support expiry dates and passwords
quote: Sharing files — links, expiry, passwords, and inviting specific people; Shared Drives — team-owned storage, membership, and roles

text: Shared Drives give teams their own storage space with members, roles, and an archive
quote: Create a Shared Drive when the content belongs to a team rather than to a person. A Shared Drive is its own storage space with its own members, roles, and archive.

text: Eight view modes for folders, including Icon, Grid, Feed, Detail, and Tree
quote: Eight ways to look at a folder — Icon, Grid, Feed, Detail, Tree, C

text: View mode and its settings are remembered per folder
quote: the mode and its settings are remembered per folder, so your photo library can stay a gallery while your documents stay a table.

text: Built-in Monaco editor with syntax highlighting, find and replace, multiple cursors, and Vim keybindings
quote: Poly includes a built-in Monaco editor... Syntax highlighting for dozens of languages, Find and replace, Multiple cursors, Vim keybindings

text: Journaling for documenting daily life, with written thoughts, file attachments, and project context
quote: Journaling gives you a quiet place to document your day-to-day life. Write a few thoughts, attach files, or add the broader context behind a project.

text: Journal entries are saved as Markdown files synced to the Mind folder
quote: New journal entries are Markdown files synced to your **Mind** folder.

text: Journal changes are saved automatically and folded into your memories
quote: Changes are automatically saved and integrated into your memories.

text: Store, browse, research, and organize files with AI on both web and desktop
quote: Store, browse, research, and organize your files with A.I. — available on web and desktop
